most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Acute potassium cyanide poisoning (suicidal ingestion), possibly with co-ingestion of venlafaxine/mirtazapine/lamotrigine
one_line_reason: Cyanide package and suicide note, sudden coma with shock, lactate 22 mmol/L with near-normal PO2 and pink non-cyanotic skin indicate blocked cellular oxygen use, which is classic cyanide toxicity.
